note: What a server sends as a camp of units that belong to no side is emptied. A client marks the camp empty, even one that had just filled. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The champion credited with emptying the camp. A client uses it only to choose a side: side 100 where the killer is on side 100, side 200 otherwise.

fields.name: camp
fields.note: Which camp. A client ignores the message for a camp it does not know.

fields.name: state
fields.note: The camp's state for that side; all eight bits count. What it carries is not recorded.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The champion credited with emptying the camp, or zero for none. Where the camp has no buff side and no line of its own, a client has that champion speak a line for it, whatever speak says.

fields.name: camp
fields.note: Which camp. A client ignores a camp it does not know, but for the timer.

bits.name: speak
bits.note: Set to have the client play the line for a camp revealed or a buff taken, to the client's own side.
